_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 10 September 2025: the Poland and WW3 session, and the mega minister.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls something coming into America that looked like a streak, given about the same time as the barge coming down the Mississippi.
mentions.quote: into America and it looked like a streak
mentions.falsify_match: An incoming object or attack over America, alongside a Mississippi river event.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The streak is not interpreted.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are being offered a way out from under Western sanctions through BRICS, and recalls the EMP attack he saw and Russia again.
mentions.quote: we will get you out from underneath the western sanctions
mentions.falsify_match: States joining BRICS explicitly to escape sanctions, with an EMP threat.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The EMP is recalled rather than newly given.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a named financier paying for the disruption to continue in the days ahead, and that it is not just him but a wider effort to bring confusion.
mentions.quote: I saw George paying for this stuff to keep continuing
mentions.falsify_match: Documented funding of political disruption by the named individual.
mentions.falsify_miss: None documented. An allegation about an identifiable living person offered on the vision alone.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls the whip making the bear and the dragon bow for a split second, but says it did not last.
mentions.quote: making the bear bow down and the dragon bow down, but it did not last
mentions.falsify_match: A brief Russian and Chinese concession followed by a return.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Note this is the version where it does not last, against the later telling where they bow for a season.

mentions.claim_text: He says the aim is to bring Cuba, Saudi Arabia and other nations into BRICS to make it strong against the American dollar, and that he then saw Canada and Mexico.
mentions.quote: to make the bricks strong to combat the American dollar
mentions.falsify_match: BRICS expansion displacing the dollar.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is not a prophet but a watchman and an intercessor whose main job is to pray and to stand on the wall and tell them what he sees on the horizon.
mentions.quote: I am a watchman. I am an intercessor. My main job is to pray
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a statement of his own office, and the standing basis on which he declines the prophet title.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw many casualties and an uprising in Israel like never seen before coming out of Turkey and Damascus, with men on foot and war drums beaten.
mentions.quote: an uprising in Israel coming out of Turkey and out of Damascus
mentions.falsify_match: A ground assault on Israel out of Turkey and Syria with mass casualties.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Two named origins and a stated method.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are targeting key states to overrun and overthrow red states and bring them into liberal thinking, adding that not all red states are as they should be.
mentions.quote: key states to try to overthrow red states
mentions.falsify_match: Republican states flipping in a coordinated effort.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The states are not named here.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was told to pray for that minister, that he saw who it was, a mega minister, and that he heard a shot around the world, insisting he is not raising it to cause fear.
mentions.quote: the shot heard around the world. Pray for that minister
mentions.falsify_match: A prominent minister shot.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He says he saw who it was and does not name him, which is a fifth withholding on file.

mentions.claim_text: He says tens of thousands, that they must get urgent about the father business, and that most are not prepared for what is coming, returning to the shot around the world.
mentions.quote: Most of you are not prepared for it
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: exhortation attached to the shot material.

mentions.claim_text: He says that the moment he closed his eyes he started seeing Germany, which came really bold, and that he sees the flag.
mentions.quote: Germany came really bold. I see the flag
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a country seen with nothing attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees black upon the land and purple in the sky, does not know why he is saying it, and describes the black as like molasses.
mentions.quote: I see black upon the land and I see purple on the sky
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: uninterpreted colour imagery, and he says he does not know why he is saying it.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch North Korea, that he sees him in the background with a devised plan, and that he comes out of the shadows and appears boldly.
mentions.quote: He becomes out of the shadows and he comes bold
mentions.falsify_match: The North Korean leader taking a prominent public role.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He appeared at the Beijing parade a week before this was given.

mentions.claim_text: He says Taiwan is lit up big and that Taiwan and China are two things at once with Russia, while attention is distracted.
mentions.quote: two things at one time. As they are distracted
mentions.falsify_match: Simultaneous crises in Europe and the Taiwan Strait.

mentions.claim_text: He names the Canadian and French leaders and says the finances of their nations are in trouble, and that he sees Germany, Italy and the euro as a whole.
mentions.quote: The finances of their nations are in trouble
mentions.falsify_match: Fiscal crises across those four states and the euro.

mentions.claim_text: He prays stability over Japan as a strategic ally, says it is very important they stay an ally, and reports hearing that they will not flip to China.
mentions.quote: They will not flip with China and go over there
mentions.falsify_match: Japan remaining aligned with the United States.
mentions.falsify_miss: Japan realigns toward China. This is a rare negative prediction, and it can fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says the same applies to Taiwan, like a mother hen gathering her chicks, and that they wrestle not against flesh and blood.
mentions.quote: like a mother hen gathered her chicklets. This is the plan
mentions.falsify_match: China drawing Taiwan in without a fight.

mentions.claim_text: He says he heard the enemy within instantly while praying over Japan, and then began seeing the southern border again and what has come over.
mentions.quote: I heard the enemy within instantaneously
mentions.falsify_match: Infiltration exposed in Japan or across the American southern border.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for the peace of Jerusalem, for a hedge around the land and for de-escalation.
mentions.quote: I pray a hedge around and about this land. A deescalation
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition.

mentions.claim_text: He says the gospel cost them something and was dear to them because of the suffering they went through, and that a great revival is coming.
mentions.quote: The gospel cost them something and it was dear to them
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an observation about persecuted believers.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over Poland, says the Lord told him they will see an escalation of things, and asks protection for their people.
mentions.quote: the Lord said you will see an escalation of things
mentions.falsify_match: Escalation involving Poland.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Given the day after Russian drones entered Polish airspace, which is what the session is responding to.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions that the new iPhone came out that day and that he hopes to order it on the 12th for a better picture.
mentions.quote: the new iPhone came out today. So on the 12th I hope to get it
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: production chatter.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a figure walking up and standing next to another with his chest bowed out proudly and his hands on his waist.
mentions.quote: he stood next to him with his chest bowed out
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a posture described, with neither figure named.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the swastika come out of the Hitler spirit, and states he is not saying this is about Germans and knows it is a sensitive subject.
mentions.quote: I saw the swastika come out of that Hitler spirit
mentions.falsify_match: A resurgent movement of that character in Germany.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He distinguishes the spirit from the nation, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Italy and others planning something together to escalate a way toward financial stability, and notes he has to remember everything.
mentions.quote: doing something together to try to have financial stability
mentions.falsify_match: A European fiscal arrangement of the kind described.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a fountain of growth coming up in the middle with an extension cord like electricity run to them, then China devising a plan to take Taiwan.
mentions.quote: an extension cord was extended to them. It looked like electricity
mentions.falsify_match: Chinese planning on Taiwan alongside an external funding line.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The extension cord recurs across the corpus without interpretation.

mentions.claim_text: He says because you are putting out fires, then he saw Hawaii again and an escalation of things in Hawaii, and then Japan.
mentions.quote: I saw Hawaii again and an escalation of things in Hawaii
mentions.falsify_match: A security escalation involving Hawaii.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw many people speaking at once in Japan with a lot of distraction and no single main voice.
mentions.quote: they were all talking in Japan but there was no main voice
mentions.falsify_match: Political fragmentation in Japan with no dominant figure.
mentions.falsify_miss: A stable leadership. Japan had had three prime ministers in five years when this was given, and Ishiba resigned the week before.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees an extension from Japan to South Korea, and a similar but less severe line running from North Korea into China like a highway.
mentions.quote: I see an extension from Japan to South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: A Japan-South Korea alignment against a North Korea-China axis.
mentions.falsify_miss: None forms. Four named states in two pairs, which is checkable.
